source.title: U113: permission and question Cards for the selected Agent or Room's Door; Moves: D2 D5 D6
source.body:
<!-- work-order:scenarios/ui-decisions.md:U113 -->
## Outcome
permission and question Cards for the selected Agent or Room's Door; Moves: D2 D5 D6

## Acceptance
Scenarios: U113
Specification: [scenarios/ui-decisions.md](https://github.com/saadshahd/roundup/blob/main/scenarios/ui-decisions.md)

## Scope
`apps/desktop/src/decisions/**` (new), the narrow mount in `App.tsx`, necessary `state/connectedProject.ts` integration, `testing/{fakeApp,seeds,stores}.ts`, `testing/harness.tsx`, related App fixtures, `.agents/data/harness.md` for Percy seeds, and only the required layout/refit changes in `terminal/Pane.tsx`, `terminal/styles.css` and their tests; reuse the Rail selection and Terminal focus APIs

## Preserve
H18 seam, U12, U25, U37, U40, U133; `u113_` tests and rendered observers

## Dependencies
H18 H2 H3 H5 H6 H7 H8 H9 H10 H14 U133

## Delivery
No implementation PR linked yet.

## Queue
Key: U113
Priority: 3
Migration state: waiting

Imported from the Work table. The issue-backed queue is being installed; this issue does not create a second Builder. Completion requires delivery evidence, not a matching test name.

goals.statement: Selecting an Agent in the Rail, by pointer or keyboard, shows its current Decision as a Card above its Terminal. Selecting a Room shows its Door's Decision. No event steals focus or changes the selection, and other Agents stay reachable through the Rail and attention navigation.
goals.observer: `u113_` Vitest tests that render the real App against the fake App seam, plus agent-browser on `just harness decisions` selecting agent-1 to agent-3 by pointer and by keyboard

goals.statement: A permission Decision offers exactly `allow` and `deny`. An H14 `ask_user` Decision shows its question and exactly its supplied answers. An unanswerable Decision explains that it must be answered in the Terminal and offers a focus action, with no answer button. An unreadable payload shows a visible error and Terminal access, and never allows anything.
goals.observer: `u113_` Vitest card tests plus a rendered harness capture of each Decision kind

goals.statement: The App subscribes to events before it loads `decision.list`. Decisions opened, replaced or cleared during that read are reconciled by id. A webview reload restores the live Decisions, and empty results leave no Card.
goals.observer: `u113_` race tests with delayed list promises, plus a rendered reload of the `decisions` seed showing the Cards again

goals.statement: An answer sends exactly one `decision.answer` with the Decision's id, the chosen answer and the H18 proof. Answer buttons are disabled while the call is pending. A rejected call keeps the Decision, its error and a retry. Success removes only the answered id, and an older completion never removes a replacement. An external clear removes that id. When a Card clears, focus returns to the Terminal only if focus was inside the Card.
goals.observer: `u113_` Vitest tests with delayed answer and proof promises, checking recorded calls and visible state

goals.statement: A Daemon exit disables answering and shows U25's failure state. Reopening uses the new connection and the new proof. Proofs never appear in DOM text, snapshots, storage or diagnostics, and no answer is ever sent through `terminal.write`.
goals.observer: `u113_` Vitest tests covering exit and reopen with a new proof, a DOM, storage and snapshot scan for the proof string, and recorded calls

goals.statement: The Card takes space above the Terminal, with its content bounded to half the centre height. Card appearance, replacement and removal refit the emulator at most once per animation frame and keep output and scroll position. Long arguments wrap or scroll inside the Card and never clip the Terminal or cause page-wide overflow.
goals.observer: `u113_` refit Terminal integration test, plus a harness capture with long arguments at 700×800 showing no horizontal overflow

goals.statement: The Card, pending, failure and cleared states are captured at 1280×800 and 700×800, in light and dark. The D1–D10 readings are named before and after, no Check that passes on main regresses, and the visible states are in Percy's existing capture list.
goals.observer: agent-browser captures with `window.__checks()` JSON on `just harness`, plus `loop/percy.sh snapshot` showing the Card states as harness seeds

evidence.command: cd apps/desktop && pnpm exec vitest run src/decisions (main caf55898)
evidence.remaining: These tests use the fake App only. No rendered harness observer selects agent-1 to agent-3 by pointer and by keyboard. The `decisions` seed selects nothing by default, so Percy never shows a Card.
Subscribe-before-list and reconciliation have tests. Nothing tests that a webview reload restores the live Decisions.

evidence.output: u113_a_daemon_exit_disables_answering: exitDaemon -> allow disabled, banner 'daemon exited 1'
evidence.remaining: Nothing tests reopen with the new connection and new proof. Proof absence is checked only in DOM text after an answer, not in storage, snapshots or diagnostics.

evidence.command: gh pr view 393 --json body; loop/percy.sh (seeds at widths [1280] only)
evidence.output: #393 body: "Percy captures of the Card states and the D1–D10 before/after readings are not in this PR."
evidence.remaining: There are no Card, pending, failure or cleared captures at 1280 and 700, light or dark. The D1–D10 before/after readings are missing, and no Card state is in Percy's capture list.
